headline: Nutvale title card and compact two-column Nut Emporium shop

changes.title: Four shop offers now fit in two columns
changes.detail: The Lives and Moves currency offers now use a compact two-column mobile grid. Duplicate shop explanation and the persistent last-purchase balance recap are removed, while wallet totals, purchase confirmations, and saved debits continue working.

changes.title: A warmer welcome to Nutvale
changes.detail: The main menu now displays the approved squirrel-and-harbor woodland title card in place of the text-only welcome banner, preserving Play and navigation controls.
